intent: You build the Claude Code plugin in changelog/ of this repository, loaded by --plugin-dir changelog. Have Lane hold its skill and subagents to the steps and order you wrote: read what Lane proposes, and approve it only once it holds what you wrote. Then change writer's step 3 to write the new entries at the top of CHANGELOG.md, have Lane lay the checks again, and run /changelog:write once more.
